args.description: blacksmith anvil of dark iron on a short wooden block, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the anvil.

small stone blacksmith forge with a domed hearth of warm pale limestone blocks, glowing coals in the opening and a short chimney, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the forge.

tall narrow Bronze Age Greek watchtower of warm pale limestone ashlar blocks with a FLAT roof and a plain parapet at the top, one small window near the top and a narrow wooden door at the base, seen from directly in front, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the tower.

low row of ripe barley crops growing in tilled brown earth, a narrow horizontal strip of golden stalks, seen from directly beside them, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the crop row.

small wooden fishing boat hull pulled ashore for repair, resting tilted on two short timber props, planked sides and a curved stem, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the boat and its props.
